name: Dose-dense weekly Paclitaxel + Carboplatin every 3 Weeks for Epithelial Ovarian/Fallopian Tube/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
disease: Epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, and primary peritoneal cancer
histology: epithelial ovarian carcinoma (histology-agnostic backbone; high-grade serous, endometrioid, clear cell, mucinous, carcinosarcoma). Fallopian tube and primary peritoneal carcinoma are staged and treated as ovarian carcinoma and share this doublet.

biomarkers.note: The cytotoxic dose-dense carboplatin/paclitaxel backbone is not biomarker restricted. Germline or somatic BRCA1/2 and HRD status are tested to guide maintenance PARP inhibitor selection, not the doublet itself. Per Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer, OV-5 and Principles of Maintenance PARP Inhibitor Therapy (OV-D).

lineOfTherapy: first-line primary systemic therapy; a dose-dense weekly-paclitaxel alternative to every 3 week carboplatin/paclitaxel

eligibilityCriteria.requirement: epithelial ovarian, fallopian tube, or primary peritoneal carcinoma requiring primary systemic therapy
eligibilityCriteria.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
eligibilityCriteria.locator: v4.2026, OV-D 7 of 12, Carboplatin every 3 Weeks/Paclitaxel Weekly

drugs.name: PACLitaxel

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
provenance.locator: OV-D 7 of 12, Carboplatin every 3 Weeks/Paclitaxel Weekly (Dose-dense Paclitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV Days 1, 8, and 15)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026, OV-D 7 of 12. Dose-dense PACLitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV on days 1, 8, and 15 (weekly). This is the weekly dose-dense paclitaxel schedule (JGOG-type) given with every 21 day carboplatin. Requires corticosteroid and H1/H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling. Tall man per ISMP.

drugs.name: CARBOplatin

provenance.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
provenance.locator: OV-D 7 of 12, Carboplatin every 3 Weeks/Paclitaxel Weekly (Carboplatin AUC 5 to 6 IV Day 1)

drugs.notes: Source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026, OV-D 7 of 12. CARBOplatin target AUC 5 to 6 IV on day 1 (dosed to target AUC by Calvert formula), given after the day 1 paclitaxel dose. The source prints the range AUC 5 to 6; kept as the exact sourced range rather than a single value. Tall man per ISMP. Footnote n: carboplatin dosing may be adjusted for creatinine methodology per carboplatin dosing guidelines.

premedications.name: PACLitaxel premedication
premedications.notes: corticosteroid plus H1 and H2 antihistamine premedication per paclitaxel labeling before each weekly dose.

supportiveCare: antiemetics: carboplatin is moderate emetic risk; prophylaxis per emetogenicity tier on the day 1 platinum dose.
G-CSF: assess febrile neutropenia risk with the weekly schedule; growth factor support per institutional and NCCN guidance.

monitoring: CBC before each weekly paclitaxel dose and before each carboplatin dose
renal function (creatinine/GFR) before each cycle for carboplatin AUC dosing
peripheral neuropathy assessment before each dose for PACLitaxel
infusion reaction monitoring for carboplatin and PACLitaxel

doseModificationRules.condition: day 8 or day 15 ANC or platelets below institutional threshold
doseModificationRules.text: Review required. Hold the weekly paclitaxel dose per institutional protocol for the dose-dense schedule; physician decides.

core.source: DeVita, Hellman, and Rosenberg's Cancer: Principles & Practice of Oncology, 12th ed.
core.locator: DeVita establishes carboplatin/paclitaxel as the first-line ovarian backbone; the dose-dense weekly paclitaxel per-cycle dosing is taken from the guideline layer

guideline.source: Standard Guidelines (NCCN), Ovarian Cancer/Fallopian Tube Cancer/Primary Peritoneal Cancer
guideline.locator: Principles of Systemic Therapy, Primary Systemic Therapy Recommended Dosing, Carboplatin every 3 Weeks/Paclitaxel Weekly (dose-dense) (OV-D 7 of 12); Repeat every 21 Days x 6 cycles

provenanceNote: ONCQIS Standard Protocol draft for the dose-dense weekly-paclitaxel plus every 21 day carboplatin schedule for epithelial ovarian carcinoma (StewardMD reference disease ovarian_cancer, subtype #44; shared by HGSOC #45, fallopian tube #46, and primary peritoneal #47). Every dose is grounded to Standard Guidelines (NCCN) v4.2026, OV-D 7 of 12, Carboplatin every 3 Weeks/Paclitaxel Weekly: dose-dense PACLitaxel 80 mg/m2 IV days 1, 8, and 15 followed by CARBOplatin target AUC 5 to 6 IV day 1, repeat every 21 days for 6 cycles. The carboplatin AUC is kept as the exact sourced range (5 to 6) rather than a single invented value. ISMP tall man applied (CARBOplatin, PACLitaxel). No field is set to VERIFY. This remains a StewardMD Standard Protocol; no endorsement implied.
